query: Our copilot-instructions.md is two years old and no one has touched it since. Audit it and refresh what's stale.
Agents keep using npm in this repo even though we're on pnpm workspaces. Add a rule so they stop doing that.
This is a strict-tsconfig TypeScript repo but there's no typescript-specific instruction file yet. Create one.
Our AGENTS.md has grown to 40 sections and covers everything from deploy gates to code style. Split it into focused per-path instruction files.
We have a non-obvious 1Password commit-signing requirement that isn't documented anywhere. Capture it so agents don't keep hitting rejected commits.
Write learned rules into AGENTS.md from the mistakes agents made in the last three sessions.
Update the README so new contributors understand the project layout.
Add an eslint rule that forbids `any` instead of writing it down somewhere.
Fix the actual bug in the auth middleware, not the docs about it.
Create a reusable skill package that captures this instruction-upkeep workflow for other repos.
